native_result.query: Between which two races is the factor of BA degree completion -0.9568 when compared to the other?
native_result.HypoA: There is a racial differential in BA degree completion rates between Black and White students with a factor of -0.9568.
native_result.HypoB: In a logistic regression model predicting BA degree completion with an interaction between race and socioeconomic status (SES), the factor (log-odds regression coefficient) of BA degree completion is -0.9568 between Black and White individuals when Black respondents are compared to White respondents as the reference group (evaluated at SES = 0).
native_result.WorkflowB: 1. Inspected data distribution, column types, and subgroup counts across racial groups. 2. Evaluated bivariate and multivariable regression models predicting BA degree completion across all combinations of race reference categories and covariates. 3. Identified that the exact coefficient -0.9568 arises from the logit model interacting race with socioeconomic status (SES). 4. Verified parameter estimates, odds ratios, standard errors, z-scores, p-values, and confidence intervals under alternative reference categories (White, Black, Hispanic) in analysis.py.
